name: gObjectSlots
comment: 128 slots x 0x40 B de objeto (mapa e batalha); slot k = base+k*0x40; +0x0C X word 8.8, +0x10 Y word 8.8, +0x20 facing, +0x2A indice de velocidade, +0x2B grupo de animacao, +0x30 pose (GH-CU confirmado)

name: gTrackedActorSlotTable
comment: 16 bytes: byte[id] = slot+1 (0 = vago); E+0xCA4; zerada no opcode 0x06 End (GH-CU confirmado)

name: gTrackedActorHalfwords
comment: halfword por render (slot+0x4F), indice render*4; 0xFFFF = ator ativo (GH-CU confirmado)

name: gObjectScratchBlock
comment: bloco de estado de 1 opcode de objeto: [0] frames/estado, [1] fase, [2] contador, [3] recarga, [8] Y base do arco (u16), [10] = render (GH-CU confirmado)

name: gEventState
comment: base do estado do script de evento; +0xC93 sub-fase, +0xC94 argumento (GH-CU confirmado)

name: gWalkSpeedIndex
comment: byte que indexa a tabela de velocidade 0x083D2A40 (OW2; escritor nao achado)

name: gSpeedScaleTable
comment: 32 B; delta = T[+0x2A] * T[0x03006D3A] (OW2 e GH-CU)

name: gArcHeightTable
comment: 16 linhas de 0x10 B; valor (short) de cada linha = altura do arco em 1/16 px (Map_ObjectArcStep, GH-CU)

name: gObjectShadowFlagTable
comment: indexada pela pose (+0x30); != 0 cria objeto de sombra no slot 0x79+id (Map_InitObjectSprite, GH-CU)

name: Map_StartObjectStep
comment: (slot, cmd, speedIdx): +0x27 = cmd&0xF (tiles), facing = cmd>>4 via Map_SetObjectRenderSlotFacingVariant, +0x2A = speedIdx, +0x28 = 16/delta; anim por facing (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Map_TickObjectStep
comment: (slot, animFlag): move por delta conforme +0x20 (0 N: +0x10 -, 1 S: +0x10 +, 2 W: +0x0C -, 3 E: +0x0C +); fim retorna 1; SFX 0x57 nas poses 0x71/0x78/0x82-0x84 (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Map_TickObjectAnimationTimes
comment: chama Map_TickObjectAnimation delta vezes por quadro (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Map_ObjectAnimStep
comment: estado 0: anim = Overworld_GetObjectAnimationIndexForFacing(render, +0x20) e Map_SetObjectAnimationVariant; estado 1: conta [2] quadros e devolve 1 (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Map_ObjectArcStep
comment: salto de 16 quadros: Y = base - tab[+0x28][0]/16 em +0x10; +0x2C = tab2>>4; fim devolve 1 e pousa em base (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Map_TickObjectFlicker
comment: pisca do bloco 0x03006D20: fase par +0x00 = +0x32 (visivel), impar +0x00 = 0 (oculto); flag +0x2D; restaura quando bloco[0]==0 (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Event_RunAllTrackedActorsStepSequence
comment: (flagSpeed, mode): fase 0 Map_StartObjectStep (mode 1) ou Obj_StartStepNoAnim (mode 0) para cada ator ativo; fase 1 Map_TickObjectStep e Event_EndOpcode no primeiro que acaba ou no halfword 0 (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Event_RunInitiateMovingActorSequence
comment: continuacao de 0x1F/0x20: spawn + Map_StartObjectStep + Tick (nome de HC2, nao relido nesta rodada)

name: Event_RunActorStepSequence
comment: continuacao de 0x23/0x24: Map_StartObjectStep(render, move, 0) + Tick (nome de HC2; corpo nao relido)

name: Obj_StartStepNoAnim
comment: renomeado de FUN_08050124 (GH-CU): +0x27 = cmd&0xF, +0x20 = cmd>>4 direto, +0x2A = speedIdx, +0x28 = 16/delta; NAO troca animacao/sprite

name: Event_Op7F_Cont_Copy_Tracked_Actor_Records
comment: copia slot 0x4F+arg -> slot 0x30 (com X de E+0xC6E em +0x0C e Y de E+0xC70 em +0x10); slot 0x79+arg -> slot 0x5A; halfword 0x030055A0[render]=0xFFFF (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Map_SpawnTrackedObjectAtTile
comment: (packed, sprite, x, y): id = packed&0xF; slot livre; Event_SetTrackedActorSlot; Map_InitObjectSprite; packed&0x40 -> Y+5 (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Map_InitObjectSprite
comment: (actorId, sprite, tileX, tileY): render = id+0x4F; +0x2B = sprite>>4, +0x20 = sprite&3, X/Y = tile*16 + u16[E+0xC48/0xC4A] <<8; halfword 0xFFFF; +0x30 pose; sombra no slot 0x79+id (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Map_SetObjectRenderSlotFacingVariant
comment: (render, facing): +0x20 = facing, +0x21 = facing, halfword +0x06 = 12*(+0x2B)+3*facing (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Overworld_GetObjectAnimationIndexForFacing
comment: (render, facing) -> facing + 4*(+0x2B) (GH-CU confirmado)

name: Event_SetTrackedActorSlot
comment: byte[0x03006484 + id] = slot+1 (GH-CU confirmado); HE2 chamava de Map_SetTrackedObjectSlotByIndex

name: Event_GetTrackedActorSlot
comment: le byte[0x03006484+id]-1 (-1 = vago)

name: Map_ClearTrackedObjectSlotByIndex
comment: nome do Ghidra (nao relido)

name: Map_FindFreeTrackedObjectSlot
comment: nome do Ghidra; HE2 citava este endereco como Map_FindFreeTrackedObjectSlot (confirmado pelo nome)

name: Map_GetScaledStepDelta
comment: delta = T[obj+0x2A] * T[0x03006D3A] (OW2)

name: FUN_08048684
comment: chute (FN2): wrapper que le byte de tabela pelo grupo e chama FUN_08048210; sugere Icon_LookupAndMapByIndex; usado para pose em +0x30 (GH-CU pendente)
